originalScriptReproduction.doesNotReproduceSSFilter: No ss counter is present in phon1.py, phon2.py or phon3.py; the ss detector below is an explicitly declared reproduction hypothesis.

ssFilterHypothesis.provenance: Independent explicit hypothesis reproducing published numbers, not attributed to Claude implementation
ssFilterHypothesis.preprocess: phon.replace('-', '') only; preserve word spaces and punctuation; use pf for catalogue; pending-Claude positions for the lot
ssFilterHypothesis.interpretation: Graphemic filter; hyphen semantics, /j/ and target c/z convention require contextual review. Neither55 nor686 is a validated correction list.

falsePositiveAndBoundaryProbes.explanation: Removing spaces adds a hit across words; word-initial s is not an intraword intervocalic marker.
GRA-sias is a graphemic vowel-s-i hit, but target gracias has /sj/; the detector is not a literal phonetic V-s-V analyser.
